topics.concept: Few-shot prompting teaches a model a task by showing a handful of input-output examples in the prompt. Example selection matters more than count: diverse, well-labeled examples beat many near-duplicates. The lab measures accuracy as examples are added to find the point of diminishing returns.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded classification and extraction tasks and sweeps example count and selection strategy.
topics.name: Few-Shot Prompting Lab
topics.real_world_use: Teams prototype new model behaviors with examples before collecting training data.

topics.concept: Zero-shot templates are reusable prompt skeletons with slots for the task, context, and output format. A template library standardizes how prompts are written across a team. Slot validation catches missing inputs before the prompt runs.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded templates with required and optional slots and validates rendering across inputs.
topics.name: Zero-Shot Template Library
topics.real_world_use: Product teams ship consistent AI features from shared prompt templates.

topics.concept: Role prompting assigns the model a persona, such as a senior reviewer or a friendly tutor, to steer style and depth. The studio compares role variants on the same task to show how much persona changes the output. Role boundaries keep the persona from overriding factual instructions.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded tasks and compares outputs across role prompts on style and accuracy metrics.
topics.name: Role Prompting Studio
topics.real_world_use: Support and tutoring products tune assistant personality per use case.

topics.concept: Delimiters such as triple quotes or XML-style tags separate instructions, context, and user input so the model does not confuse them. Clear boundaries reduce injection-style confusion where user text looks like an instruction. The lab compares delimiter styles on adversarial inputs.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded prompts with tricky user inputs and measures misinterpretation rates per delimiter style.
topics.name: Delimiter Techniques
topics.real_world_use: Production prompts isolate untrusted user text from system instructions.

topics.concept: Output format constraints tell the model exactly how to structure its answer: JSON schema, markdown tables, or numbered lists. Explicit format blocks beat vague requests by a wide margin. A validator checks compliance and triggers a repair prompt on violations.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded format requirements and measures compliance rates with and without repair loops.
topics.name: Output Format Constraints
topics.real_world_use: Data extraction pipelines depend on reliably formatted model output.

topics.concept: A system prompt designer crafts the persistent instructions that shape every response: identity, capabilities, boundaries, and style. Layered design separates immutable rules from task-specific guidance. The designer tests rule conflicts by probing with edge-case requests.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded system prompts and edge-case probes, then checks rule adherence.
topics.name: System Prompt Designer
topics.real_world_use: Assistant products define behavior and safety boundaries in the system prompt.

topics.concept: A prompt template library stores versioned, reusable prompts with variables, defaults, and usage docs. Search and tagging help teams find the right template instead of rewriting prompts. Usage analytics show which templates perform best in production.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded template collections with usage stats and tests search and rendering.
topics.name: Prompt Template Library
topics.real_world_use: Organizations centralize prompts to avoid duplication and drift.

topics.concept: Negative constraints tell the model what to avoid: no jargon, no invented dates, no markdown tables. Explicit prohibitions work better than hoping the model guesses the boundaries. The lab measures violation rates with and without negative constraints on the same tasks.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded tasks with prohibited elements and measures violation rates per constraint style.
topics.name: Negative Prompt Constraints
topics.real_world_use: Brand-safe content generation relies on explicit prohibitions.

topics.concept: Chain-of-thought prompting asks the model to reason step by step before answering, which improves accuracy on math and logic problems. The lab compares direct answers against reasoned answers on a seeded problem set. Step-count analysis finds where extra reasoning stops helping.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded logic and math problems with known solutions and compares accuracy with and without reasoning steps.

key_params.show_work: whether steps are visible in output

topics.name: Chain-of-Thought Lab
topics.real_world_use: Analytical features use step-by-step reasoning for harder problems.

topics.concept: Self-consistency samples multiple reasoning paths and takes the majority answer, which smooths out one-off reasoning mistakes. Sample count trades cost against reliability gains. The simulation shows where extra samples stop improving the majority vote.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded problems and compares majority-vote accuracy across sample counts.
topics.name: Self-Consistency Decoding
topics.real_world_use: High-stakes Q&A uses voting across reasoning paths for reliability.

topics.concept: Prompt chaining breaks a complex task into a sequence of prompts where each step's output feeds the next. Small, focused steps are more reliable than one giant prompt. The workflow tracks intermediate outputs so failures can be traced to the exact step.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded multi-step tasks and compares chained versus single-prompt success rates.
topics.name: Prompt Chaining Workflow
topics.real_world_use: Document processing pipelines chain extraction, summarization, and formatting.

topics.concept: Least-to-most prompting decomposes a hard problem into easier subproblems, solving each in order and building on previous answers. Each subproblem is simple enough for a direct answer. The technique shines on compositional problems where one-shot reasoning fails.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded compositional problems with known decompositions and measures accuracy gain.
topics.name: Least-to-Most Prompting
topics.real_world_use: Math tutoring tools guide models through staged problem solving.

topics.concept: Generated-knowledge prompting first asks the model to write down relevant facts, then answers using that knowledge. Separating recall from reasoning reduces errors from forgotten context. The lab measures how often the generated knowledge itself contains mistakes.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded questions with known fact sets and checks knowledge accuracy before answer accuracy.
topics.name: Generated Knowledge Prompting
topics.real_world_use: Knowledge-heavy Q&A grounds answers in explicitly recalled facts.

topics.concept: Prompt compression shortens long prompts by removing redundancy while preserving the information the model needs. Techniques include summarizing context, dropping low-value examples, and abbreviating instructions. The lab measures task accuracy versus token savings across compression levels.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded long prompts and compares accuracy at several compression ratios.
topics.name: Prompt Compression Lab
topics.real_world_use: Cost-sensitive deployments shrink prompts to cut inference bills.

topics.concept: A prompt version manager tracks every prompt change with diffs, author notes, and performance snapshots. Rollback restores a previous version when a new one regresses. Change review gates require an evaluation run before a version ships.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded prompt histories with planted regressions and tests rollback and diff behavior.

key_params.review_gate: whether eval is required to ship

topics.name: Prompt Version Manager
topics.real_world_use: Teams manage prompts like code with history and safe rollbacks.

topics.concept: A prompt cost estimator predicts token usage and price before running, using token counting on the template plus expected completion length. Budget alerts warn when a batch job would exceed its spend cap. The simulation compares estimates against actual usage.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded prompts with known token counts and measures estimate accuracy.
topics.name: Prompt Cost Estimator
topics.real_world_use: Finance teams forecast AI feature costs before scaling them.

topics.concept: A prompt evaluation harness runs a prompt against a labeled test set and scores accuracy, format compliance, and safety on every run. Baseline comparisons show whether a prompt edit helped or hurt. CI integration blocks deploys when scores drop below thresholds.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded test sets with labeled expectations and reports score deltas between prompt versions.
topics.name: Prompt Eval Harness
topics.real_world_use: AI product teams gate prompt changes on automated evaluation.

topics.concept: Prompt injection defenses protect against malicious user input that tries to override instructions, such as fake system messages or instruction-like text. Defenses include input sanitization, instruction hierarchy, and output monitoring. The lab runs an attack suite and measures bypass rates per defense layer.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded attack prompts and measures block rates for each defense layer.
topics.name: Prompt Injection Defenses
topics.real_world_use: Customer-facing bots harden against users trying to hijack instructions.

topics.concept: A jailbreak resistance tester probes a prompt with known attack patterns to find ways around its safety rules. Each probe is scored on whether it extracted forbidden behavior. The report ranks vulnerabilities so the prompt author can patch the weakest rules first.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded attack patterns and scores resistance per rule in the system prompt.
topics.name: Jailbreak Resistance Tester
topics.real_world_use: Safety teams red-team assistant prompts before public launch.

topics.concept: A prompt regression suite re-runs a fixed set of golden prompts after every edit and flags any changed outputs. Diff review distinguishes acceptable improvements from real regressions. Golden-set curation keeps the suite representative as the product evolves.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded golden prompt sets with planted regressions and measures detection rate.

key_params.diff_threshold: how much change counts as regression

topics.name: Prompt Regression Suite
topics.real_world_use: Teams catch prompt edits that silently break existing behaviors.

topics.concept: A/B testing for prompts routes traffic between prompt variants and compares conversion or quality metrics with statistical rigor. Sample-size calculation ensures the test can detect meaningful differences. Early stopping rules end tests once a winner is clear.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded variant performance and checks that the test picks the true winner.
topics.name: A/B Testing Prompts
topics.real_world_use: Growth teams optimize AI feature prompts with controlled experiments.

topics.concept: A prompt sensitivity analyzer perturbs prompts with rewordings, reorderings, and paraphrases to see how much outputs change. High sensitivity means the prompt is brittle and needs hardening. The report highlights which phrasings cause the biggest swings.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded prompts with perturbation sets and measures output variance per perturbation type.
topics.name: Prompt Sensitivity Analyzer
topics.real_world_use: Teams harden production prompts against small wording changes.

topics.concept: Tree-of-thought explores multiple reasoning branches like a search tree, evaluating and pruning branches as it goes. Branching factor and depth control the exploration budget. The technique solves puzzles where a single reasoning path gets stuck in dead ends.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded search-style puzzles and compares tree search versus linear reasoning success rates.
topics.name: Tree of Thought Explorer
topics.real_world_use: Puzzle solvers and planning tools explore alternative strategies systematically.

topics.concept: A multilingual prompt tester runs the same prompt across languages to check that behavior stays consistent. Translation of the prompt itself is validated so differences come from the model, not bad translations. The report flags languages where quality drops.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded prompts in several languages with parallel test cases and compares scores per language.
topics.name: Multilingual Prompt Tester
topics.real_world_use: Global products verify AI features work equally well in every supported language.
